verdict.rationale: Check documents an official Check MCP Server that works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT. It offers a hosted remote option you connect to with just a URL, supporting OAuth for people in an AI client or API keys for server-side agents, plus a read-only mode. A self-hosted option adds configurable toolsets, and natural-language payroll, employee and report operations are documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate reliably through the MCP server.
